reason: Sessions resumed after a break found the throwaway test Postgres stopped, and spent several tool calls, including a classifier-denied command, before it was back. A reusable recipe for checking, restarting and seeding the local test database belongs in one skill that every database-backed proof reuses.

In the episode, the Playwright run failed on a bare TEST_DATABASE_URL (connected as role root) and the web server timed out; the agent also had to pick a database name that did not collide with the proof-writer's. The skill named the variable but not the URL shape, the naming rule, or the build time.

Absorbed as the 'local test Postgres for proofs' section of the Postgres umbrella; its restart procedure is carried as references/restart-test-postgres.md, with the data folder moved under /var/tmp to match the scratch-folder rule.
